instructions: Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes, stirring often, until they smell toasty. Transfer them to a plate to cool, then chop them.
In a large bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, sugar and 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Cut the apples into 1/2-inch chunks, leaving the skin on, and add them to the bowl right away. Toss to coat. Halve the grapes and dice the celery.
Add the grapes, celery, raisins and walnuts and stir until everything is coated.
Serve now, or cover and chill for 1 hour. To pack it, keep it in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The apples stay crisp for about a day.
method_notes: Spend With Pennies is the lead (5 out of 5 from 60 ratings) and Daring Gourmet (5 from 60 votes) agrees on apple, grape, celery and toasted walnut in a mayonnaise dressing with raisins. Once Upon a Chef and Love and Lemons add yogurt, honey and herbs; the lead keeps it to mayonnaise and sugar. This follows the lead and takes the lemon juice from Daring Gourmet, Once Upon a Chef and Love and Lemons so the cut apple holds its color. No honey or yogurt is used, so it's vegetarian and gluten-free.
